part.label: Orifice Plate With O-Ring Groove
part.description: A sealing plate with a circular O-ring groove cut into its top face, using a `torus` component with `operation: "subtract"` -- confirming (real-kernel-verified) that the newer component kinds added this session work as subtract/intersect operands, not just as `add` shapes. A central through-hole passes fluid/air through the plate; the groove alone seats a standard O-ring around it.

components.description: O-ring groove: 28mm pitch diameter, 3mm cross-section, centered on the plate's top face. torus sits with its own base (not center) at Z=0, so position.z is the plate's thickness minus the tube radius, putting the ring's center exactly on the top surface.
